replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Triggers

Triggers are events that run when a flag is called. Here are some example uses for triggers:
  • When a player enters a region, give the player speed.
  • Upon shooting a bow, change the arrow into an enderpearl.
  • Modify the drops of a specific block type.
  • Portals: Enter a region and teleport a player to a point
You can look here: http://docs.avicus.net/components/regions 
At the end of the page is an exsample.
